{{Quote|We suspect there might be some sort of Imperial Installation hidden in the asteroid field. Look for the shield projectors. Be careful, Wedge. The Imperials probably don't want any visitors.|General Rieekan to Rogue Squadron|<ref name="RS II" />}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a '''prison installation''' on a [[Asteroid/Legends|planetoid]] near [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. The [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] was placed under complete secrecy, although rumors relating to its existence persisted.

==Description==
[[File:Maw_Imperial_Prison_map.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A map of the facility]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison facility in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] contained various facilities within the compound, including the main prison buildings, a weapons storage building, communication relays to nearby [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and several two landing platforms, including one for [[Imperial tanker|tankers]]. Those facilities and more were also connected via a repulsorlift railway system that also held the facility together. The communication relays, placed at the far corner of the facility, consisted of seven towers. An environmental dome was placed in the installation between the weapons storage and the relays.<ref name="RS II guide" /> Magma spots were also seen on the surface.<ref name="RS II" />

It was heavily armed with various turbolaser turrets that acted as guard towers as well as various [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] walkers. Guard towers were placed near the prison building as well as the weapons storage facility. Another group was near a landing platform.<ref name="RS II guide" />

Other than the turbolaser turrets, the facility also was constantly guarded by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] both inside and in the outside perimeter. In addition, a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield]] was placed in the outer perimeter of the facility, although it needed the generators to be fully functional, as otherwise, if three projectors were disabled, the hole will be large enough for a small fighter squadron to penetrate the field.<ref name="RS II" />

==History==
[[File:Starwarsrogueleader06.jpg||right|thumb|250px|Antilles flying near a relay tower.]]
After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] loss at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> several Rebel personnel, including [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]], had been found and captured on the [[Hoth/Legends|frigid planet]], sent to the installation.<ref name="RS II" />

Some time after the battle, Rebel [[General/Legends|general]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], suspecting its presence in the Maw, sent [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to [[Battle near the Maw|investigate]], and disable the shield projectors. Upon arrival in the asteroid field, they ended up discovered by a fleet of Imperial tankers, so they were forced to hold them off while also disabling a number of the shield projectors enough to sufficiently disable the shield and grant them entry. Approaching the prison, they were contacted by Karie Neth requesting their assistance in helping her and several of the prisoners escape from the facility. Neth transferred the target data to them. First, they needed to eliminate the guard towers guarding the prison building so she and a few of the other escaped prisoners could release the rest. After that was accomplished, they then requested that Rogue Squadron destroy the guard towers for the weapons storage building so they could raid its weapons stock.<ref name="RS II" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
Antilles bombed one of the environmental domes and recovered [[advanced cluster missile]] technology.<ref name="RS II" />
{{Endgame}}

Upon accomplishing it, Rogue Squadron was then tasked with destroying the communications relays to prevent the alarm from being sent to the Star Destroyers patrols. Afterwards, they destroyed the guard towers around the rail system to ensure that the [[Armored hovertrain|repulsorlift train]] that the prisoners hijacked could make it to the platform. Finally, the prisoners commandeered a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class shuttle]] and then entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], detonating explosives that they planted around the rail system, destroying the facility.<ref name="RS II" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prison installation appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''. The mission in which it appears is also included in the game's sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', in the co-op version of ''Rogue Squadron II.'' The base also houses a vehicular upgrade, and this article assumes the player collected it.

The prison also serves as a location for a Versus Mode match in ''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike''.
